title: Three Idiots — Opening Credits Proposal
summary: A 15-second hype intro on a hip-hop beat. It opens with a beat drop, gives each host a freeze-frame name card cut on the beat, runs a fast montage of game moments, and ends on a logo slam. It goes between the cold open and the episode, so every episode opens the same way.

what_we_borrow: A hip-hop beat sets the pace, and every cut lands on a beat
Each host gets their own moment and name card
Real clips from the show, not stock footage
The same intro every episode, so it becomes the show's signature
reference.note: These are the general traits of a hype-style show intro. Watch the FRDi intro again before locking the edit and change anything that doesn't match the feel you like.

placement.edl_section: Add a 'credits' section between 'cold' and 'intro' in edit/edl.json

music.style: Boom-bap / modern hip-hop instrumental with a hard drum drop
music.math: At 92 BPM one beat is 0.652 s and one 4/4 bar is 2.61 s, so 6 bars ≈ 15.6 s

structure.what: Filtered intro: melody only, no drums, with a vinyl crackle or record scratch
Full beat drops on the first downbeat of bar 2
Beat plays 3 beats, then cuts to silence on beat 4 for the logo hit

where_to_get_it.note: Safe for YouTube monetization. Filter by Genre: Hip Hop & Rap.
Bigger, higher-quality catalog. Covers YouTube, TikTok and Spotify video.

where_to_get_it.source: BeatStars lease or a commissioned beat
where_to_get_it.note: A beat only you use. Read the lease terms for streaming limits.

where_to_get_it.source: Make it in GarageBand or BandLab
where_to_get_it.note: Fully yours. Cut the beat to exactly 6 bars.

music.avoid: Commercial songs, even 10 seconds. Content ID will flag or demonetize the episode.

visual_style.type: Helvetica Neue Bold, all caps, tight letter spacing. Matches the 'DON'T DO DRUGS.' shirt.
visual_style.freeze_frames: Black-and-white freeze frame, host cut out with a thick white sticker outline, film grain
visual_style.motion: Hard cuts on beats, 2–4 frame camera shake on drum hits, no slow fades or glossy 3D

shot_list.visual: Black screen. Three 0.4 s flash-cuts of reactions: Omar 'builds character', Ahmad hitting the airhorn, Ahsan cracking up.
shot_list.audio: Filtered intro + record scratch on the last beat

shot_list.visual: Beat drops. Freeze frame of Ahsan, cut out on black, punches in 110% on the downbeat.
shot_list.text: AHSAN (big, white) / 'BUILT THE GAME APP LAST NIGHT' (small)

shot_list.visual: Freeze frame of Ahmad, same treatment.
shot_list.audio: Airhorn on beat 1 (the one from the episode)

shot_list.visual: Freeze frame of Omar, same treatment.
Montage cut on 8th notes (0.33 s each): buzzer spam, Thermostat answer stack, 'IMPOSTER' chip reveal, Fast Money banner, group laughing.
shot_list.text: Game graphics already in the edit
shot_list.audio: Beat continues. Buzzer SFX on the first two cuts.

shot_list.visual: Group shot of all three. On beat 4 the music cuts, the screen goes black and the logo slams in.
shot_list.audio: Silence on beat 4, then one bass hit with the logo

per_episode_changes: Swap the bar 5 montage for moments from that episode
Optional: change each host's subtitle to a joke from that episode
build_steps: Pick the beat and trim it to 6 bars at 92 BPM (or re-time the shot list to its tempo)
Export freeze frames of each host from the camera files at the timestamps above
Cut out the hosts (Photoshop 'Remove Background', or remove.bg) and add a white outline
Build the 15 s sequence in CapCut / Premiere / DaVinci, or as a 'credits' section in edit/build.py
Snap every cut to a beat marker
Render once as intro.mp4 and reuse it, changing only bar 5 and the episode number
open_questions: Final show name, since 'Three Idiots' is a placeholder
Free library beat or a beat only you use
Are you all happy with your name-card subtitles?
